Citron Da Nang
Jun 2026 • Couples
I had a wonderful dining experience at Citron Restaurant. The food was delicious, beautifully presented, and full of authentic Vietnamese flavors. I especially enjoyed the local specialties, which were fresh and well-prepared.

The restaurant’s atmosphere was equally impressive. The elegant design, unique cone-shaped seating areas, and stunning panoramic views of the ocean created a relaxing and memorable dining experience. The staff were friendly, attentive, and provided excellent service throughout the meal.

Overall, Citron is a fantastic place for anyone looking to enjoy great food, beautiful scenery, and exceptional hospitality in Da Nang. I would highly recommend it and would love to visit again.

Amazing restaurant
Jun 2026 • Solo
Citron offers a premium dining experience with an impressive atmosphere, a unique concept, and a beautiful panoramic ocean view. The food quality is consistently good, with a diverse menu combining both Vietnamese and international cuisine, catering to a wide range of guest preferences.

One of its strongest highlights is the overall service experience. The team demonstrates professionalism, friendliness, and attentiveness, creating a welcoming and comfortable environment for guests. The elegant ambiance and distinctive concept make the restaurant memorable and elevate the overall dining journey.

During peak hours, service speed may occasionally be affected by the high volume of guests, which can slightly impact consistency. However, overall, it remains an exceptional dining destination that delivers a high-quality and memorable experience.
